grounded_answers.question: When does the central library close on weekdays?
grounded_answers.answer: The central library closes at 8:00 PM on weekdays, from Monday to Friday (ce26995d-318c-4399-bbaa-99e2da120306).

grounded_answers.question: How many books may a student borrow at one time from the central library?
grounded_answers.answer: An enrolled student may borrow at most four (4) books at one time from the central library. A book is issued for fourteen (14) days and may be renewed once for an additional fourteen days if not reserved by another reader (source: ce26995d-318c-4399-bbaa-99e2da120306).

grounded_answers.question: What is the late return fine per book per day?
grounded_answers.answer: The late return fine is five (5) rupees per book per day, counted from the day after the due date. The maximum late-return fine charged for one book is three hundred (300) rupees, after which the borrower must replace the book [Retrieved chunk 78a909f6-64fa-4068-97c2-ff916061eb63].
